profiles.officialName: Schneider Electric Motion Deutschland (formerly Berger Lahr)
profiles.shortDescription: Berger Lahr, the German motion-control and stepper-motor/servo-drive maker founded in Lahr in 1941, became a Schneider Electric company in 2000 and was renamed Schneider Electric Motion Deutschland in 2008.
fullDescription: Berger Lahr, now Schneider Electric, offers products, systems and complete solutions for positioning and automation including comprehensive consulting and engineering services - from the development stage through production and commissioning.
In 2008, Berger Lahr changed the company name to Schneider Electric Motion Deutschland, and integrated its products and services into the offering of Schneider Electric.
The motion products are a part of Schneider Electric's Lexium range.
1941: Founding of Berger Lahr by Gerhard Berger in Lahr (Germany).
In 1972, Berger Lahr developed the worldwide first 5-phase stepper motor and in 1993 the first 3-phase stepper motor worldwide.
In 1999, Berger Lahr launched its first integrated drive which comprised motor and electronics in a single unit.
Today, Berger Lahr is a manufacturer of high-quality servo drives and motors, linear axes and systems.
Berger Lahr offers a complete Motion Control product range for machine automation: Motion Controllers, Drives & Motors and Linear Motion.
In 2000, Berger Lahr became a company of Schneider Electric.
STE, STA and STM are listed by Schneider Electric as the (Berger Lahr) product range within Industrial Automation and Control > Motion Control & Robotics, now marked discontinued.

profiles.shortDescription: ECONOSTO Oy is a Finnish valve supplier founded in 1987 and based in Kuopio, part of KLINGER Finland since 2022, offering a broad twenty-category range of valves, actuators, safety devices and regulators.
fullDescription: ECONOSTO Oy, founded in 1987, is a valve supplier based in Kuopio, Finland, and has been part of KLINGER Finland since 2022.

The company's published product range spans twenty valve and regulator categories, including butterfly valves, ball valves, knife gate valves, check valves, safety valves, pneumatic and electric control valves, and pressure reducing valves.

Over half of ECONOSTO's deliveries are customized prefabrications assembled to individual customer specifications, and the company holds ISO certification covering quality, environmental and occupational health and safety management.

profiles.shortDescription: Швейцарский производитель промышленных насосов, арматуры и защитных клапанов для энергетики, химической и целлюлозно-бумажной промышленности.
fullDescription: Invent Armaturen AG — швейцарская компания (Nelkenweg 26, CH-4512 Bellach), поставляющая промышленные насосы, арматуру (клапаны) и оборудование техники безопасности.
Продукция компании применяется в химической, фармацевтической и целлюлозно-бумажной промышленности, а также на объектах централизованного теплоснабжения и атомных электростанциях.
Линейка Prozess-Pumpen включает одноступенчатые насосы серии LSB, LSN, LN/L, LS/LC/LCP и канало-колёсные насосы KS, а также многоступенчатые насосы MP/MPA/MPB/MPV.

В программе насосов для инженерных систем зданий представлены самовсасывающий насос JEX, спиральные насосы 2CDX/CDX, вертикальный многоступенчатый насос EVM, моноблочный насос LPS и однoступенчатые линейные насосы LMR и SNL.

В разделе фильтров и грязеуловителей низкого и высокого давления компания публикует модели Grobfilter ND 551, Flanschfilter ND 552, Hochleistungsfilter NHD 553, Schmutzfänger NHD 554, Schmutzfänger HD 555 и HD 556.
Защитная арматура для насосов включает свободнопроточные обратные клапаны серии MRM, TDC, TDM, TDL и SUL для многоступенчатого снижения давления перед центробежными насосами.

profiles.shortDescription: JVM® is Jöst GmbH + Co. KG's drives-technology brand for dosing drives, magnetic drives, exciters and unbalance motors used in bulk-material handling.
fullDescription: JVM® is a brand of Jöst GmbH + Co. KG (JOEST), a German vibratory-equipment manufacturer founded in 1919 and headquartered in Dülmen.
The JVM line covers dosing drives (including the JD series), electromagnetic and magnetic drives, exciters and unbalance motors used for dosing, feeding, mixing and conveying bulk materials.
The former standalone brand site j-vm.com now redirects into JOEST's own site, where the JVM product pages are published under joest.com/jvm-drives/.

profiles.headquarters: Via Giuseppe Mazzini 6, 24060 San Paolo d'Argon (BG), Italy
fullDescription: LVF S.p.A. is an Italian manufacturer of forged and cast gate, globe, check, ball and DB&B valves for the Oil, Gas, Chemical, Petrochemical, Power Generation and Marine industries.
Established in 1984, LVF is headquartered at Via Giuseppe Mazzini 6, San Paolo d'Argon (BG), Italy, and operates four manufacturing plants covering the full production process.

LVF's product range published on its own site includes Gate Valves (bolted bonnet, welded bonnet, pressure seal, solid or flex wedge, parallel slide), Globe Valves, Check Valves, Ball Valves, Modular DB&B and SB&B valves, and Through Conduit Gate Valves, built to ANSI 150#-4500# in sizes from 1/2" to 36", per ASME B16.34, API 602, BS5352, ISO 15761, API 600, API 6A and API 603.

profiles.officialName: Kendrion Aerzen (formerly Magneta GmbH & Co. KG)
fullDescription: Kendrion N.V.'s own history page states that Kendrion Aerzen was 'previously Magneta GmbH & Co. KG', with production and employees moved to Kendrion INTORQ's Aerzen facility to make it a competence center for spring-applied and magnetic particle brake technology.
Kendrion INTORQ's Aerzen site is listed as an active Kendrion location at 31855 Aerzen, Germany, described as an expert for fail-safe brakes with ongoing production and R&D.

Kendrion's Magnetic Particle Clutches & Brakes product line — the technology sold under the Magneta name — transmits torque through specially alloyed, highly abrasion-resistant iron powder inserted into the particle gap between rotors, with the transmittable torque continuously adjustable via the electromagnetic field current.
EM Brno s.r.o. is the direct successor to the former Czechoslovak state enterprise MEZ Brno and has continued its traditional line of electric motors since 1996.
The works trace back to a small workshop founded in Brno-Židenice in 1909, nationalized in 1946, and merged in 1958 into the state enterprise MEZ Brno.

Current production covers industrial DC motors (M series), DC traction motors (3M), spindle-drive DC motors (V), externally-ventilated AC motors (1AY), built-in AC motors (4TM/5TM), electrohydraulic devices (EP), Exd-rated ATEX explosion-proof AC motors (AOM), AC servo motors (5NK), gearless elevator machines (MEZOLIFT NL), and LUN-series dynamostarters and voltage regulators for LET 410 aircraft.
The company also repairs and services motors and drives from the former MEZ Brno enterprise, manufactures stamping and cutting tools for motor production, and performs CNC and EDM machining.

profiles.shortDescription: Norton Clipper is a Saint-Gobain Abrasives brand making diamond blades and cutting machines (masonry, tile and floor saws, cutting tables, core drilling rigs) for construction.
fullDescription: Norton Clipper is a brand of Saint-Gobain Abrasives.

Norton Clipper's 'Building & Construction' catalogue, published on Saint-Gobain's own media platform, covers diamond tools and blades (concrete, tile, natural stone, asphalt), and a dedicated 'Norton Clipper Machines' chapter covering tile saws, masonry saws, handheld cut-off saws, floor saws and drilling rigs.
Clipper produced the first masonry saw in 1937 and Norton Clipper patented the first laser-welded diamond saw blade in 1982, before Clipper was brought into the Norton/Saint-Gobain family in 1990.

sources.scope: Confirms Norton Clipper is a Saint-Gobain Abrasives brand and lists its diamond-tool and cutting-machine product categories (tile saws, masonry saws, handheld cut-off saws, floor saws, drilling rigs)

profiles.shortDescription: OTECO, Inc. is a Houston, Texas manufacturer of oilfield rig equipment since 1948, including its Model 6/7/8 pressure gauges, gate valves and relief valves.
fullDescription: OTECO, Inc. has been a leading manufacturer of high quality oilfield equipment and accessories since 1948.

Beyond its extensive array of rig hardware and consumables — including Gate Valves, Relief Valves, Pressure Gauges, Fluid End Consumables and Replacement Rubber Products — the company also offers custom-made rig Shock Pads and the OTECO Connector.

Oteco pressure gauges are offered as Model 6, Model 7 and Model 8, with pressure ranges from 0 to 20,000 psi, available in standard, sour gas and saltwater service, and certified by the American Bureau of Shipping.

sources.scope: Confirms Model 6, Model 7 and Model 8 pressure gauge series, pressure ranges and certifications
Confirms company description, 1948 founding, and product scope (gate valves, relief valves, pressure gauges)

profiles.headquarters: C. Salvador Albert i Riera, 9 (Pol. Ind. Vallmorena), 08339 Vilassar de Dalt, Barcelona, Spain
profiles.shortDescription: Pedro Gil, part of Ingersoll Rand since 2022, is a Barcelona-based (125+ year) manufacturer of lobe, screw and turbo blowers and high vacuum pumps.
fullDescription: Pedro Gil has been providing technologically advanced, high performance air blowers with excellent durability for more than 100 years, and now more than 125 years.
Pedro Gil's vacuum range includes RV, RNV, RVRB and SCREW vacuum pumps, among others.
Pedro Gil's headquarters, world-wide design center, manufacturing and support center is located in Vilassar de Dalt, Barcelona, Spain.

Pedro Gil has officially joined Ingersoll Rand, a leading manufacturer of critical flow technologies including compressors, blowers, vacuum pumps and power tools, while Pedro Gil continues to trade as normal.

sources.scope: Confirms company description, blower/vacuum pump product range, and vacuum series (RV, RNV, RVRB, SCREW)
Confirms Barcelona headquarters address as world-wide design center, manufacturing and support center
Confirms Pedro Gil joined Ingersoll Rand as parent company

profiles.shortDescription: Индийский производитель принадлежностей для станков — револьверных головок и автоматических магазинов смены инструмента (ATC) для обрабатывающих центров.
fullDescription: Pragati Automation Pvt. Ltd. была основана в 1977 году как производитель принадлежностей для станков (копировальные суппорты, копировально-фрезерные головки, зажимные цилиндры).

Компания выпускает автоматические магазины смены инструмента (ATC) барабанного типа для вертикальных обрабатывающих центров (VMC): жёсткое крепление узла ATC для гашения вибрации при смене тяжёлого инструмента, привод поворота барабана кулачковым индексатором или сервоприводом, энкодер синхронизации, ёмкость магазина 20, 24, 30 и 40 инструментов.

profiles.shortDescription: Dutch supplier of OEM-compatible spare parts for poultry processing equipment.
fullDescription: Rodon International B.V. is a Dutch company with more than 30 years of experience supplying OEM-compatible spare parts for the poultry processing industry.
The company's headquarters have been located in Hillegom, the Netherlands, since it moved to new premises in 2013.

Rodon's own product menu covers the full poultry-processing line — including defeathering, eviscerator, cropping, cut-up and filleting machines — and includes a dedicated 'Blades & knives' category split into circular blades and straight blades.

profiles.shortDescription: Turin-based manufacturer of axial fans, engine-cooling systems and heat exchangers, formerly known as Rosati S.r.l. / Rosati Fratelli.
fullDescription: Wingfan S.r.l. traces its origins to Rosati S.r.l., founded in Turin in 1935 in sheet-metal processing, which began producing axial impellers for combustion engines in 1950 and complete axial ventilators from 1985.

The company began marketing axial impellers under the Wingfan brand in 2015, added cooling-system production in 2017, acquired the radiator and heat-exchanger business of Tecno Group Industry S.r.l. in 2019, and formally renamed itself Wingfan S.r.l. in 2022.

Wingfan manufactures custom axial fans with AC or EC motors, FanClutch engine-cooling solutions, HVAC/refrigeration ventilation validated in its own AMCA wind tunnel, and heat exchangers (radiators and intercoolers) for air, water and oil cooling.
Its headquarters are at Via Susa 15 in Turin, its operating facility is at Via Torino 212-272 in Leinì, and it carries VAT registration IT 00465940013.

profiles.shortDescription: Welding and cutting equipment brand, now operated as one of Lincoln Electric's own brands after the original saf-fro.com site went offline.
fullDescription: SAF-FRO is listed by Lincoln Electric as one of its own brands: under Lincoln Electric's Equipment brand group (alongside Lincoln Electric, Oerlikon and Harris) and under its Consumables brand group (alongside Oerlikon, Indalco, Weartech and Techalloy).
Lincoln Electric hosts a dedicated Saf-fro product catalogue page on its own site describing Saf-fro welding and cutting equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Swedish manufacturer of milling, turning, holemaking and tooling-system cutting tools, part of the Sandvik group.
fullDescription: Seco Tools was founded in Fagersta, Sweden, and has grown into a global supplier of precision cutting tools for milling, turning, holemaking and tooling systems.

Seco's milling range includes indexable milling cutters and exchangeable-head mills such as the MP10 series with the F40M and MP3000 interfaces, published on Seco's own site under model designations including MP10-10012R04Z3-E03 F40M and MP10-10012R04Z4-E02 F40M.
Seco Tools' own site links to Sandvik's group-wide governance and whistleblowing page, reflecting its position within the Sandvik group.

sources.scope: company profile page (Fagersta founding, Sandvik footer link)
exact model page matching catalogue evidence (MP10-10012R04Z3-E03 F40M)

profiles.shortDescription: Safety-valve and engineered-valve-systems brand of IMI plc's Process Automation business.
fullDescription: IMI Bopp & Reuther is a safety-valve and engineered-valve-systems brand of IMI plc's Process Automation business, described on its own brand page as having more than 150 years of engineering heritage with over 150,000 valves installed worldwide.

Its Si-series safety valves, including Si 6 and Si 910, are published as current products on IMI plc's Process Automation site, which also lists the ARS high-pressure turbine bypass valve and MSV reheater safety valve under the sibling IMI CCI brand hosted on the same domain and parent company.
These products serve power, nuclear, marine and process industries.

profiles.shortDescription: Австрийский производитель вакуумного упаковочного оборудования (камерные и ленточные машины, термоусадочные и сушильные туннели) для пищевой промышленности.
fullDescription: Supervac Maschinenbau GmbH was founded in Vienna, Austria in 1952 and began manufacturing single-chamber vacuum packaging machines in Austria shortly after; the company relocated to a new facility in Mödling in May 2021.
The company's conveyorized ('belt') vacuum packaging line is the GK series, spanning models such as GK 169/170 B through GK 950/960 B with sealing bar lengths from 660 to 1600 mm.
A dedicated soft-vacuum belt-machine range (GK ... B Soft series, e.g. GK 800 B Soft, GK 501 B Soft, GK 195 B Soft) is offered for delicate/soft-packaged products.
Supervac also builds spraying tunnels (AS 400, AS 660/860) and a drying tunnel (BL 15), alongside shrink tanks, cooling tunnels and automated bag-handling systems (Superbagger, Easybagger).
Machines are delivered to 130 countries through a network of 55 representative offices worldwide.
